tools.name: check_store_ai_readiness
tools.description: Audits a public store homepage (+ robots.txt, sitemap, one sampled product page) and returns a heuristic 0–100 AI-shopping readiness score with the top ≤10 gaps and fixes (schema.org Product/Offer, AI search bots in robots.txt, sitemap, HTTPS, policies). Read-only; no login; does not detect WAF/CDN

tools.name: audit_product_page
tools.description: Audits one public product page: schema.org Product/Offer (JSON-LD), price/currency/availability coherence with visible text and og:price, GTIN/MPN check digit, images, return/shipping markup, and robots.txt / noindex access for OAI-SearchBot, Googlebot and other AI bots. Cannot verify WAF/User-Agent

tools.name: validate_feed_for_chatgpt
tools.description: Fetches a public product feed (XML RSS/Atom, CSV, TSV, JSONL) and checks it against the OpenAI Commerce products feed spec (required: item_id, title, description, url, brand, seller_name, image_url, availability, price; plus GTIN check digit, sale_price, placeholders). Returns % SKUs OK, issue count

tools.name: validate_feed_for_google
tools.description: Fetches a public product feed and checks Google Merchant Center required/recommended attributes (id, title, description, link, image_link, availability, price, brand, gtin/mpn/identifier_exists, condition, apparel attributes, product_type…) plus coverage of the May-2026 conversational attributes (qu

tools.name: draft_supplemental_feed
tools.description: Turns structured issues (the `issues` array returned by validate_feed_for_google / validate_feed_for_chatgpt / audit_product_page) into CSV text of suggested corrections (title, gtin, identifier_exists, product_type, availability, price, seller_name, Q&A template columns).
